The portion that dissolved is AgCl forming the soluble [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺ complex.

This confirms the presence of **Hg₂²⁺** (mercurous ion).

3. **Hg₂²⁺** (Mercurous) - confirmed by gray color when treated with NH₃
